rawRegistration: 128/outputWidth plus full logical offset(32,56); square outputs only, no fit
roleAssignment: Trace attachment through bends to paw before examining targets; assign each observed paw once. Missing or ambiguous critical role fails.
soleRule: Parent selects actual isolated paw ROI and component seed after unmarked topology review. Score alpha192 lowest boundary midpoint; alpha128 and connected lower contour bands4/8/16 rawpixels quantify threshold/sole-definition uncertainty. Do not select nearest target pixel or neighboring disconnected toe component.
uncertainty: Include source sampling, threshold sensitivity, underside-definition sensitivity and annotation ambiguity; record vertical component separately.

acceptance.layout: truealpha, intact square registration, no guides/props/parts
acceptance.topology: both near attachments and bend orders correct, all4roles andsoles independently identifiable
acceptance.farStance: max norm at t=5/12 and6/12 using actual measured paw and approved worldcontact, plus uncertainty<=3logicalpx
acceptance.nearBends: measure observable bends with uncertainty; hidden/inferred bone centers never copied from targets

failurePolicy: One B edit attempt only. If geometry moves, stop this generation route; no alpha replacement, warp, fitting, per-paw movement or adjacent frames.
